title: LST pilot atlas

scene_observation.label: Satellite observation time
scene_observation.description: Compare the model with Landsat at the exact listed scene acquisition time. Observed temperature is available only on valid satellite pixels.
scene_observation.target_rule: target_datetime_utc equals the selected scene datetime_utc exactly
scene_observation.validation_status: Evaluated on held-out sample pixels and dates; full-raster coverage is computed separately

experimental_daytime_hour.label: Experimental daytime hour
experimental_daytime_hour.description: Use earlier surface reflectance with weather for the selected historical daytime hour. This is a model estimate; no coincident satellite observation is implied.
experimental_daytime_hour.target_rule: UTC target within 2021–2024; daytime; optical_source_datetime_utc <= target_datetime_utc; age <= 90 days
experimental_daytime_hour.validation_status: Arbitrary-hour and cloudy-sky predictions are experimental; nighttime is unavailable

reported_air_scenario.label: Daytime reported-air scenario
reported_air_scenario.description: Experimental daytime prediction with a supplied air temperature and a fixed surface snapshot. The entire selection must be sunlit; nighttime and near-horizon requests are unavailable pending a model trained and tested on nighttime surface behaviour.
reported_air_scenario.daytime_method: Shared daytime ML model; new-hour and cloudy-sky accuracy unvalidated
reported_air_scenario.nighttime_method: Withdrawn: coarse weather cells are not a learned fine-scale surface prediction.

eligibility.criterion: QA water_fraction exactly zero AND a recognised Köppen class; frozen before model assessment
eligibility.reason: Twenty independent WorldCover point checks found both permanent water and real coastal land in unknown-climate samples. These unresolved rows are quarantined, not relabelled ocean.
eligibility.scope: Temporary pilot eligibility; does not establish an independent 100 m coastline/land-fraction mask. Terrestrial snow with known climate is retained.

refinement.description: Adding 46,800 labelled London pixels from fixed blocks did not improve later-date accuracy. The candidate failed the predeclared checks and was not deployed. A pixel can teach the model only when its satellite label and weather describe the same actual conditions; manual-air scenarios are excluded from supervised feedback. A second, capped Cfb residual correction also stopped at its development checks: London date-balanced MAE improved 4.417 to 4.171°C, but one Cabauw date worsened 1.304 to 1.539°C. No 2025 test labels were opened after that rejection. More independent weather dates are needed; the 5–7°C misses remain unresolved.

cohort_notes.london_2024: 381 original sampled pixels across two dates; distinct from the all-year London headline above. These previously inspected dates are a preserved retrospective comparison, not a fresh blind test.
cohort_notes.london_hot_2024: 45 pixels. Means do not bound the error at every pixel.
cohort_notes.london_cold_2024: 135 pixels. More independent cold-weather dates are needed.
cohort_notes.temporal_2024: 3,413 pixels across 20 dates and 11 other pilots.

ui_copy.subtitle: Surface temperature from air temperature, surface reflectance, climate and recent weather.
ui_copy.what_is_lst: LST is the temperature of the surface seen from above: leaves, soil, roofs or paving. It differs from shaded air temperature reported by a weather station.
considered: Air temperature, adjusted by local station readings where timely observations exist
Vegetation, built/bare and water spectral contrasts; reflectance-based albedo proxy
Surface elevation, slope, direction and nearby relief
Köppen climate, sun angle, season and local mean solar hour
Humidity, wind, cloud, rain, soil moisture, incoming shortwave and longwave radiation, snow water equivalent and recent weather history
not_yet_considered: Individual buildings and trees, detailed cast shadows or sky-view factor
Explicit evapotranspiration, material heat storage or waste heat
Validated nighttime, under-cloud or arbitrary-hour surface temperatures
ui_copy.empty_state: Choose a listed daytime satellite scene or a fully sunlit daytime scenario. Nighttime surface prediction requires suitable training and validation and is currently unavailable.
ui_copy.interval_label: Empirical uncertainty band; not a guaranteed range
ui_copy.air_source_label: Station-adjusted ERA5 or ERA5-only; shown for this result

limitations: This is a 12-area research pilot, not a validated worldwide product.
Evaluation uses selected clear-sky daytime Landsat observations. Nighttime, under-cloud and arbitrary-hour accuracy have not been independently established.
100 m is the output grid spacing, not a guarantee of 100 m independent thermal or weather detail.
Weather context is coarse ERA5. Most air temperatures are station-adjusted spatial estimates; no station measures every map pixel.
Detailed building and tree heights, cast shadows, sky-view factor, explicit evapotranspiration and anthropogenic heat are not inputs in this fitted version.
Albedo proxy captures reflectance differences; it does not substitute for explicit shade geometry.
The fitted model uses one shared estimator conditioned on climate class; it is not a separate model for every climate or a direct nearest-place lookup.
The empirical interval is shared across pixels and has no guaranteed coverage after geographic, weather or surface change. Coverage was weaker in Gobabeb and Utqiaġvik.
Metrics describe sampled eligible pixels and independent region/date blocks, not every cell of each full-area raster. Pixel counts are not independent date counts.
The original fitting eligibility mask was provisional. Website rasters add an independent WorldCover land-fraction mask; the saved model was not refitted or re-evaluated using that new mask.
Reported-air scenarios use a fixed optical snapshot that can precede or follow the requested time. They do not reconstruct historical or future vegetation, snow, soil or construction changes.

Scenario dates span 1900–2100. Outside complete requested-hour ERA5 coverage, weather other than reported air comes from a single same-season/hour reference day in 2023; this is neither observed weather for the request nor a climatological mean.
The former coarse ERA5 night baseline has been withdrawn. Nighttime and near-horizon requests are rejected before source retrieval; archived results remain explicitly withdrawn audit records.
